author: Amanjeet Singh
prior_information: All locked primary and six sensitivity estimates, supplementary zero-product tests, precision arithmetic and source-only QR/sign-interval algebra are known. New joint contrasts, pooled interaction results, rotation outcome ranges and predetermined-outcome tests have not been inspected. This is not blind prospective registration.

contrasts: median earlier-period minus median full sample
joint_stability.covariance: Joint contribution arrays embedded on common calendar, with own sqrt(n/(n-k_full)) corrections and common Bartlett L=18; L=17 sensitivity. Cross-equation and overlapping-sample dependence retained.
joint_stability.inference: Product-difference image of a four-coordinate 95 per cent Wald ellipsoid and a conservative Bonferroni rectangle; regular direct-difference normal interval is separately diagnostic.
joint_stability.equivalence: Report infimum symmetric margin containing the full confidence set, without choosing a margin or claiming equivalence from a failure to reject equality.
joint_stability.pooled_period: Origins through 2018-12 versus 2019-01 onwards; full 308 origins. Common lag dynamics and calendar controls, period intercept and interactions of both current components. Test two response-slope interactions jointly. Do not apply the single-gap identity to period-interacted coefficients.

rotation_set.source: Pinned event-factor construction, author exclusions and rate normalisation unchanged.
rotation_set.angles: Entire strict financially admissible interval, including one-sided closure limits; no arbitrary endpoint trimming.
rotation_set.estimation: Use invariant raw-factor/QR-coordinate regressions and exact invertible transformations, verify against median and several interior direct fits. Show identified coefficient/gap ranges, singular limits and common-source conditional simultaneous inference where supported.
rotation_set.uncertainty: Separate conditional sampling uncertainty from identification-set width; no claim to cover re-estimation of factor loadings, event covariance or sign-set endpoints.

causal_assessment.target: Relative production response to a latent policy innovation contributing ten basis points to the supplied rate factor.
causal_assessment.diagnostics: Three predetermined production changes accumulated over 13 months from t-26 to t-13: durable, non-durable and difference. Primary current components, 72 controls, 308 origins, L18 calendar-HAC and n/(n-74). Two-coefficient Wald test for each outcome, Bonferroni adjustment over three. Outcome contrasts and covariance retained; non-rejection is not proof of exclusion.
causal_assessment.sensitivity: Under explicit constant noiseless mixing and orthogonality, evaluate beta_m+a*(beta_c-beta_m), where a is a stated information-component loading of a ten-basis-point latent policy intervention. Show breakdown in a and an explicit outcome-confounding bias allowance, not an estimated contamination amount.
causal_assessment.instrument_rule: No component is relabelled a valid external instrument without substantive relevance and exclusion evidence. Causal responses remain conditional or partially identified if source assumptions are unverified.

precision: Assess uncertainty relative to existing estimates and the jointly assessed differences. Do not select controls, periods, angles, bandwidths or estimators for significance. Smoothness restrictions require a separately justified bias/inference procedure and do not create identification.
verification: Independent coefficient/covariance/algebra and optimisation checks; retain adverse and null findings. Reproduce selected scientific quantities in base R through the existing research checks.
reporting: Keep locked primary files unchanged; include extension design, numerical findings, identification limits and deviations in the existing paper, maximum 20 pages including appendices and bibliography.
